notes: Eleven items were queued from this feed and nine had text to read; two were duplicates of the same shelter-arrest story already read here. Mission Local runs two weekly roundup columns — Tenderloin Buzz and Mission Buzz — and between them they name most of the street numbers in this batch. A roundup's headline names its lead item only, and a headline is the whole of what we publish, so the second and third businesses in a column have no usable entry however real their openings are: those are declined on the headline, not on the fact. No person named in any of these stories is recorded here.

coverage.note: Twelve numbered addresses appeared across five stories. Four are passing venue mentions inside the Tenderloin Buzz column — an event at 33 Turk St, a play at 835 Larkin St, a cafe at 740 Market St — and one is a taqueria gathering at 2399 Folsom St in Mission Buzz; none of the five says anything about the building it names, so they are covered here rather than as findings. Coverage was reconciled against the queue during the publishing pass: eleven Mission Local items were queued and this block had recorded nine, so the outstanding two were read then. All five items in this batch that produced no finding — “San Francisco is getting organ-ized”, the Golden Gate Bridge sentencing story, the shelter-worker arrest story, “Looking west from Kearny Street” and “Innercity home” — name no street address at all.

findings.description: The corner building that housed Central Drug Store, an independent pharmacy of 117 years that has since closed, changed hands in June 2026 according to city records. A building permit filed 1 July and already approved adds a second street address, 10 Santa Rosa Avenue, to the storefront on the same corner — the city's own addressing permit on this parcel reads "create the address 10 santa rosa ave". The buyers are private individuals and are not recorded here.
